rule.pl: Kazda istotna zmiana, test, awaria, rollback, nowy modul, nowa czesc i decyzja projektowa trafia na WWW. Nie polegamy na pamieci czatu.
rule.en: Every significant change, test, failure, rollback, new module, new part and project decision is documented on the web. Chat memory is not the source of truth.

status_policy.WORKING: Only after a successful real functional/voice test.
status_policy.CODE_OK: Code compiles or passes static checks, but real test is still pending.
status_policy.TESTING: Installed or prepared and currently under real-world testing.
status_policy.FAILED: Real test failed or caused a regression.
status_policy.ROLLED_BACK: The failed change was reverted to the previous known state.

current_priority.title: Restore listening after failed local-dialogue deployment
current_priority.details_pl: Po ostatnim wdrozeniu local dialogue ring zapalil sie na czerwono i Kora przestala slyszec. Najpierw cofamy zmiane, sprawdzamy wake/audio/ring, dopiero potem projektujemy kolejna wersje.
current_priority.details_en: After the latest local-dialogue deployment the ring turned red and Kora stopped hearing. First restore the previous state and validate wake/audio/ring; only then design the next version.

active_issues.summary: Local dialogue deployment caused red ring and loss of listening; rollback requested.
English spontaneous answers can fall into laptop_ollama_en_lang_guard and repeat generic secretary-like wording.
English time questions must be handled locally and must not fall through to generic conversation/model routing.
The wake recognizer has previously reacted to 'Marzena'; false wake handling needs measured retest after rollback.

safety.rule: STOP/release/PWM-off and core listening must take priority over personality, local dialogue and model routing.

next_test: Confirm wake/listening works with a single spoken 'Kora'.
Confirm ring returns to normal listening state.
Do not modify personality/router until wake/audio are confirmed restored.
